answer: Verdicts by lottery jury: each answer is graded by a panel of 7 drawn at random from established identities, and the draw uses the epoch seed so no submitter can predict or bribe its graders. Jurors stake 38 POA behind every verdict; a verdict overturned on appeal slashes the stake and burns the seat. The saffron of the draw is public, the karst of stakes makes grading junk a losing trade, and the river of overturned verdicts pays the wronged author.
